name: How long does it take to complete a handrail repair?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to complete a handrail repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of handrail repair depends on the scope and complexity of the damage. Minor repairs, such as tightening a loose post or fixing a small section, might be completed within a few hours to a single day. More extensive projects involving structural reinforcement, significant material replacement, or custom fabrication could take several days. We provide an estimated timeline after our initial assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair times vary; minor fixes can take a few hours to a day, while extensive repairs might take several days, depending on the damage.
